chunks: And in it, that the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, Allah, the Exalted and Glorified, did not grant Satan authority over the believers except for he who made him a guardian (wali).
And He granted him authority over every one who follows him.
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for Satan having authority over a believer according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq highlights this conditional authority to refute the Mu'tazila and others who debated the extent of Satan's power, emphasizing that *wilayah* is a matter of volition rather than compulsion. This distinction underscores the Shia doctrine of free will, where believers retain agency to either submit to the Devil's whispers or remain steadfast in divine obedience.
